title: Copy-on-write: before a write
purpose: Show two processes sharing pages A,B,C until a write triggers copying.
requiredChecks: Process 1 and Process 2 each have virtual pages A,B,C.
There are exactly three physical page boxes A,B,C, each shared by both processes.
Exactly six distinct mapping arrows connect each process page to its matching physical page; no private copy exists yet.
The title states before a write and the shared page C is visibly read-only/COW-protected, with legible labels.
alt: Before copy-on-write: both processes share the same physical pages A, B and C
prompt: Create a NEW original English technical blog diagram. White background, crisp dark navy large sans-serif labels, flat blue/teal outlined shapes, generous whitespace, simple unambiguous connectors, no decorative art, no logos or watermark. TITLE "Copy-on-write: before a write". Three vertical columns: left "Process 1 — virtual pages" with A,B,C; center "Physical memory" with A,B,C; right "Process 2 — virtual pages" with A,B,C. The columns are widely spaced with clean connector channels. Each process's virtual A maps only to physical A, B only to physical B, C only to physical C. Exactly SIX arrows, all arrowheads pointing to physical memory, with straight horizontal routes aligned to the corresponding page rows. Label physical C "C — COW protected". Show no duplicated C page yet and no write arrow. Use text only, no memory-stick artwork. Footer exactly "Shared pages are copied only when written". All A/B/C identifiers and both process numbers must be exact.
